source_notes.trashnet: TrashNet labels cardboard and paper are intentionally grouped into application class paper; its trash label is only a candidate mapping to other. TrashNet does not provide organic, textile, or electronics coverage. Verify dataset license and labels before use.
source_notes.taco: TACO provides litter instance annotations, not these eight direct image-level classes. Create and review a versioned annotation conversion before using it; no automatic mapping is asserted here. Verify license and attribution requirements before use.
